title: Zeroth derived global sections preserves quasi-coherent coproducts
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme]. In $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category], let $(E_i)_{i\in I}$ be any set-indexed family of objects with quasi-coherent cohomology, and let $\iota_i:E_i\to S$ exhibit $S$ as their ambient coproduct. Put $F(E)=H^0(R\Gamma(X,E))$ as an additive group, using the module-valued global-sections functor [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology] and its unbounded derived functor [def-pc-global-derived-rhom]. The homomorphism $\bigoplus_{i\in I}F(E_i)\to F(S)$ induced on the i-th summand by $F(\iota_i)$ is bijective. The assertion includes the empty family and arbitrary unbounded complexes.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-derived-global-sections-preserves-coproducts] to the given ambient quasi-coherent cofan to obtain a colimit in the derived Γ(X,O_X)-module category.
Apply the fully proved [lem-pc-derived-module-homology-coproduct] in degree zero to get a colimit of the cohomology modules.

Use Mathlib ModuleCat.coproductCoconeIsColimit to identify this colimit with the concrete direct sum. Its unique comparison map is an isomorphism. Verify the map on each coprojection by toModule_lof and colimit extensionality. Mathlib coe_toModule_eq_coe_toAddMonoid identifies the underlying function with the displayed DirectSum.toAddMonoid; ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso proves bijectivity.

theorem derivedGlobalSections_cohomology_coproduct (X : Scheme.{u})
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] :
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤)))
    let F := (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).rightDerivedFunctor ⋙
      DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤))) 0 ⋙
      forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤))) AddCommGrpCat
    ∀ (I : Type u) (E : I → schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
      (S : schemeDerivedCategory X) (ι : ∀ i, (E i).obj ⟶ S),
      IsColimit (Cofan.mk S ι) →
      Function.Bijective (DirectSum.toAddMonoid (fun i ↦ (F.map (ι i)).hom) :
        (⨁ i : I, F.obj (E i).obj) →+ F.obj S)
